title: NBA SOTA 20h — Uncertainty-Aware RNN + ELO Feature Priority

sources.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
sources.key_result: RNN + Monte Carlo Dropout; integrates team-level metrics, rolling-form indicators, spatial shot-chart embeddings. LR and XGBoost both achieve Brier ~0.20 on 2024 NBA test season.

sources.title: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
sources.key_result: Stacked ensemble (Nature Scientific Reports). Competitive with SOTA.

sources.title: Machine Learning for Basketball Game Outcomes: NBA and WNBA Leagues
sources.key_result: CNN model achieves Brier 0.221 — competitive with our fleet best 0.22062.

gap_to_sota.note: Our TabICL best is 0.21139 (holdout, window-biased). Honest gap to SOTA LR/XGBoost is ~0.02 on CV basis.

actionable_proposals.description: SOTA paper identifies home_next, team_elo_5_y, team_elo as top-3 predictors. Audit features/engine.py to confirm these ELO rolling features are present and not being filtered out by MAX_FEATURES=200 cap.
actionable_proposals.action: Search features/engine.py for 'elo' category. If elo_rolling_5y and home_next_game_indicator are present, verify GA islands select them (check island logs for feature indices). If absent, propose adding to engine v3.2.
actionable_proposals.expected_impact: Potential 0.005-0.010 Brier improvement if ELO features are currently under-weighted.

actionable_proposals.description: SOTA uses rolling-form indicators as explicit feature category. Our engine has form features but SOTA combines them with shot-chart spatial embeddings for context. Port: add 10-game rolling win% differential + points-per-possession rolling delta as explicit features.
actionable_proposals.action: Add to features/engine.py: team_rolling_10g_win_pct_diff, team_rolling_10g_ppp_diff. Test on S14 random_forest as control island.
actionable_proposals.expected_impact: Small (~0.001-0.003) improvement but orthogonal to current feature set.

actionable_proposals.description: RNN+MC-Dropout achieves Brier 0.20 via uncertainty-aware calibration, not just prediction accuracy. Apply MC-Dropout-style calibration post-processing to our tree ensemble outputs (already have isotonic calibration; add Platt scaling + temperature scaling ensemble).
actionable_proposals.action: In island eval loop: after tree model predict_proba, apply sklearn CalibratedClassifierCV(method='sigmoid') as stacking head. Measure Brier delta vs. raw isotonic.
actionable_proposals.expected_impact: 0.002-0.005 Brier improvement on top of current 0.22062. Already partially implemented (isotonic).

cross_project_insight: The ELO and rolling-form feature dominance found in NBA SOTA maps directly to political prediction — political event outcomes similarly depend on entity historical momentum (legislator vote consistency, party approval rolling average). Port: add political_entity_rolling_10cycle_brier_delta to political engine as feature category.
next_steps: Verify ELO features exist in features/engine.py (audit 'elo' category)
Check if home_next feature is in island selected-feature logs
Queue rolling-form injection for S18 (extra_trees, stagnation 4 cycles — diversify opportunity)
